---
name: Performance report
about: Share reproducible throughput or resource-use results
---

Describe the workload and expected performance. Include both endpoints' hardware,
kernel, MSC commit, storage, link speed/MTU, RTT/loss, socket limits, file sizes,
flow/socket counts, checksum setting, and command.

Report repeated completion times, CPU/memory if available, and independent byte
verification. Distinguish data-phase throughput from launch-to-completion time.
Attach benchmark metadata/results with sensitive paths and addresses redacted.
